nodes.summary: A real fresh restriction creates a balanced pair on a single physical name.
nodes.title: A fresh restriction pair is balanced

nodes.summary: An empty external interface is balanced. Internal ν channels still require their own balanced ownership and are not thereby completed.
nodes.title: The empty interface is balanced

nodes.summary: Every owned role has its opposite role at the same physical name, with the same rank and the dual protocol. This condition may permit deadlocks.
nodes.title: Balanced endpoint ownership

nodes.summary: A balanced complete interface supplies compatibility for every present pair.
nodes.title: Balanced interfaces are compatible

nodes.summary: A partial interface is compatible if opposite roles, WHEN both are present, have dual protocols. A missing peer is not an enabled-edge witness.
nodes.title: Compatibility of a partial endpoint interface

nodes.summary: A dual-compatible pair of physically equal but disjoint owned keys must be opposite roles. The runtime channel name alone does not supply this.
nodes.title: Disjoint owned keys on one name have opposite roles

nodes.summary: Capture-safe rekeying transports balance when endpoint roles are retained. The injectivity condition is on owned keys, not on arbitrary passive data.
nodes.title: Rekeying preserves balance

nodes.summary: Any left subcontext of a compatible interface retains compatibility of its present pairs; no global-progress assumption is involved.
nodes.title: Compatibility passes to the left part of a union

nodes.summary: A right child of a disjoint linear split inherits compatibility of its present pairs from the combined interface.
nodes.title: Compatibility passes to the right part of a disjoint split

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
